name: @dna-platform/build
description: The compiler for the public library — it lifts what is written in library/, carries it into the app, assembles it into books, judges them, and catalogues what survives. Node-side only; nothing here ever reaches a browser bundle.

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && tsx tests/walking.ts && tsx tests/building.ts && tsx verify.ts ../../.test-library
